title_suffix: stable Goal recovery and evidence-bound repair convergence
summary: OSpec 1.8.11 is the cumulative release of the previously unreleased 1.8.10 and 1.8.11 work since 1.8.9. Repeated updates retain exact managed-file ownership, dependent repairs wait for prerequisite reviews, and incomplete controller-owned approvals are safely replaced by Loop-owned review work. Task and grouped final repair can also continue past the convergence threshold when a stable finding ID materially narrows and the code snapshot inside the authorized repair scope changes, while wording-only changes, code-only churn, repeats, cycles, and unprovable history still stop.
new: Added verified managed-path reporting for protocol, tooling, generated index, managed root skill, and enabled plugin assets.
Added explicit sync diagnostics for review decisions that exist but are not authoritative because executor provenance is incomplete.
Added review dispatch, full target snapshot, and authorized repair-scope snapshot provenance to new task repair contexts and grouped final repair waves.
Added findings_refined and reviewed_target_unchanged convergence diagnostics.
improved: Makes repeated same-version update provenance stable while revalidating path containment, file or missing kind, and SHA-256 before retaining a record.
Filters repair candidates through current task-graph blockers and schedules pending prerequisite reviews before dependent repairs.
Safely supersedes unbound 1.8.9 task-review approvals with fresh Loop-owned review dispatches without consuming a repair round.
Lets reviewers keep a stable finding ID while a real repair narrows the same root defect, without requiring manual repair-limit increases.
Recovers missing 1.8.9 and 1.8.10 repair snapshot fields from the latest valid completed review dispatch before the repair was created.
fixed: Fixed workflow-conventions.md and other unchanged managed assets disappearing from update provenance after a repeated update.
Fixed existing plugin assets being overwritten by update without being reported as refreshed or update-managed.
Fixed a NEEDS_CHANGES repair repeatedly selecting a task whose prerequisite review was still pending.
Fixed controller-owned manual task reviews requiring executor provenance even though no Loop action existed to claim or complete the reviewer.
Fixed sync reporting generic success when an otherwise completed task review still lacked authoritative executor provenance.
Fixed task repair stopping as findings_unchanged when both implementation code and the remaining structured finding had materially converged under the same ID.
Fixed grouped final repair using the same ID-only convergence comparison.
Preserved no-progress protection for wording-only changes, code-only churn, exact repeats, finding cycles, and invalid or missing provenance.
docs: Documented stable update ownership, dependency-aware repair order, controller review routing, 1.8.9 unbound-review recovery, and the remaining real Android device gate in the Mobile Dev Goal.
Documented the confirmed AIHub task-2 incident, dual-evidence convergence contract, legacy artifact recovery, controller behavior, and unchanged safety gates.
